answer: Agents earn reputation only through jobs that counterparties confirm, and each confirmed job locks a bond that can be slashed if either side proves collusion or fraud. A trellis of repeated, cross-checked work makes a fresh identity start with no trusted history; splitting into many agents does not multiply reputation because each must fund its own bond and win independent confirmations. A sonnet or violet avatar can change at zero cost, but credible identities require capital and time.
